Asmodeus.description: Tied to the Lord of the Nine Hells, granting manipulative fire magic and commanding presence.

features.name: Blood of Asmodeus
features.tldr: Your innate spells focus on fire and deception, supplementing your standard infernal legacy.

Mephistopheles.description: Tied to the archdevil Mephistopheles, granting arcane flair and raw destructive power.

features.name: Blood of Mephistopheles
features.tldr: You gain access to fiery arcane magic such as the *Burning Hands* spell.
